cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

types_v5/CollateralRedeemerV5.title: CollateralRedeemerV5
types_v5/CollateralRedeemerV5.description:
Collateral redeemer (v6). Unlock spends the deposit with a settlement proof
 (commitment-bound + Merkle membership of the private R in the pool's
 `repaid_root`, read via pool_ref). Carries NO borrow-shared value.

types_v5/DepositDatumV5.title: DepositDatumV5
types_v5/DepositDatumV5.description:
Collateral deposit datum (v6). No amount — the commitment (Merkle leaf =
 Poseidon255(collateral_amount, secret)), a timestamp, and `unlock_to`: the
 address the collateral is paid to on unlock. Fixing the recipient at deposit
 means a copied unlock proof cannot redirect the collateral (front-running);
 it reveals nothing new, since unlock spends this very deposit anyway.

types_v5/PoolDatumV5.title: PoolDatumV5
types_v5/PoolDatumV5.description:
Lending pool datum (v6). The pool UTxO carries the one-shot pool NFT; the
 verification keys are validator parameters, not datum fields.
 `group_root`          -> append-only Merkle root of the collateral commitment
                          set; grown PERMISSIONLESSLY by DepositCollateral via
                          a ZK append proof (no admin)
 `group_next_index`    -> next free leaf position in the group_root tree
 `repaid_root`         -> append-only Merkle root of repayment nullifiers R;
                          grown PERMISSIONLESSLY by Repay via a ZK append proof
                          (no admin), so unlock can prove settlement in zero knowledge
 `next_index`          -> next free leaf position in the repaid_root tree
 `external_nullifier`  -> fixed protocol constant scoping loan nullifiers
 `repay_external_nullifier` -> DISTINCT protocol constant scoping repayment
                          nullifiers, so R cannot be correlated with the
                          borrow-time loan_nullifier
 `collateral_denomination` -> every collateral deposit is exactly this many
                          lovelace (checked on-chain at DepositCollateral);
                          Borrow checks it covers loan_denomination at the ratio
 `loan_denomination`   -> every loan is exactly this size, so loan amounts are
                          uniform (carry no per-loan information) and open_loans
                          need only store nullifiers, not principals.
 `open_loans`          -> outstanding loan nullifiers (what Repay may settle)
 `used_nullifiers`     -> every loan nullifier ever borrowed against; never
                          shrinks, so one deposit backs exactly ONE loan and a
                          repaid deposit's R can never cover a later loan

 Lender side (one lender note = one pool share):
 `total_deposited`     -> cumulative lovelace paid in by AddLiquidity
 `lender_root`         -> append-only Merkle root of lender note leaves; grown by
                          AddLiquidity via a ZK append proof
 `lender_next_index`   -> next free leaf position in the lender tree
 `total_shares`        -> shares outstanding (notes added minus notes withdrawn)
 `lender_nullifiers`   -> withdraw nullifiers W of notes already paid out; never
                          shrinks, so each note pays out once
 `lender_external_nullifier` -> protocol constant scoping W
 `share_start_price`   -> price of a share while no share is outstanding
 `liquidity_reserve`   -> lovelace that stays in the pool UTxO (min UTxO); it is
                          neither lendable nor part of the share value
 Share value = pool lovelace - liquidity_reserve + total_borrowed (outstanding
 loans are pool assets). Free liquidity = pool lovelace - liquidity_reserve.

types_v5/PoolRedeemerV5.title: PoolRedeemerV5
types_v5/PoolRedeemerV5.description:
Lending pool redeemer (v6).
 `AddLiquidity`: a lender buys one share: pays exactly the current share price
 (rounded up) and `append_proof` attests the note leaf `commitment` is appended
 at `lender_next_index`, taking lender_root -> out.lender_root.
 `WithdrawLiquidity`: `proof` attests a note in `lender_root` with withdraw
 nullifier `withdraw_nullifier`, bound to `recipient`; the pool pays the current
 share price (rounded down) to that key, from free liquidity.
 `DepositCollateral`: a collateral output of exactly `collateral_denomination`
 with this `commitment` is created, and `append_proof` attests the commitment
 is appended at `group_next_index`, taking group_root -> out.group_root.
 `BorrowAnonymous`: the proof is bound to `recipient`; the loan must be paid
 to that key (front-running protection).
 `RepayAnonymous`: `proof` is a repay proof binding `loan_nullifier` AND
 `repay_nullifier` to one secret. `repay_nullifier` = R = Poseidon255(secret, repay_external_nullifier);
 `append_proof` attests R is appended at `next_index`, taking repaid_root ->
 out.repaid_root (permissionless — no admin signature on repay).
